hero.headline: Master Your
hero.subheadline: Battle Beacon connects players with every Friday Night, draft, and pre-release at their local game stores. For stores, Beacon CRM manages seatings, events, and player engagement in one place.

pain.sectionSubheading: Events go unannounced, match records are lost, and stores waste time on admin instead of building their communities.

items.title: Missing FNM Slots
items.description: Friday Night events and draft nights fill up before you hear about them. Announcements are buried in Discord servers or Facebook pages you forgot to check.

items.title: No Competitive Record
items.description: Your match wins, format history, and milestones exist only in memory. Nothing to show for years of competitive play across formats.

items.title: Stores Fill Events Manually
items.description: Coordinating seatings, communicating with players, and managing prizes across multiple platforms costs stores time they could spend on the floor.

items.title: Hard to Find Opponents
items.description: Getting games outside of FNM means hoping someone replies to a Discord post before the evening is over.

solution.sectionSubheading: The command layer your local game store community has been missing.

items.title: Never Miss an Event
items.description: See every FNM, draft, pre-release, and casual session at local stores in one place. Set alerts so you are always first to claim a seat.

items.title: Build Your Record
items.description: Track wins across every format, earn badges, and build a competitive profile that captures your full history in the game.

items.title: Store Event Tools
items.description: Beacon CRM gives stores one system for seatings, prizes, player comms, and marketing without juggling separate tools.

cta.heading: Get In Before Launch
cta.subheading: Sign up early for your exclusive early adopter badge and be first notified when Battle Beacon goes live at your local game store.
